messages:
maria: PTAL — pushed a tiny follow-up that fixes backoff math and adds a smoke test. Ran locally, waiting on CI. Can we get 2 eyes? I'd like to schedule canary Tue 09:00 PT if CI green.

maria: diff is literally two lines: changed default backoff from 100->150ms and added a retry reset in the error path.

maria: smoke command I ran:
```
make smoke TEST=backoff && ./tools/smoke --seed=42
```

nate: looking now, will run the smoke in my env. quick q: does the new default affect burst traffic? :thinking:

nate: also can you paste the failing case you hit?

maria: It was a rare local repro where rapid retries caused the rate limiter to mark the connection; fix prevents immediate re-retries. No perf regression in perf tests I ran.

jaan: skimming — code looks good. left one tiny nit inline about renaming var `b` to `backoffMs`, PTAL. Otherwise :+1:

maria: thanks — renamed and pushed. updated commit message.

ci-bot: CI started for commit abc1234 (maria/backoff-fix). Tests: unit(✓) integration(✓) smoke(✓) flake? none.

kevin: I can take a second approve after lunch, but if someone else can approve earlier to hit Tue 09:00 PT canary that'd be great.

nate: gave an approve via GH :thumbsup: — small nit not blocking.

jaan: approved — small var rename nit fixed. go ahead w/ canary slot.

maria: thanks all — scheduling canary Tue 09:00 PT and adding note to rollout doc.

maria: FYI CI link: https://ci.example.com/build/abc1234

kevin: noted. I'll watch the canary rollout and join the 09:15 sync if there's anything.

maria: done, thanks :rocket:
